```sql
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
th AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Duplo'
    UNION
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
cur AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
ce AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN cur ON c.parent_kind = cur.parent_kind
            AND c.parent_num = cur.parent_num
            AND c.version = cur.v
),
roots AS (
    SELECT set_num FROM sets
    WHERE year = 2017 AND theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM th)
),
x(root, kind, num, qty, is_spare) AS (
    SELECT r.set_num, ce.child_kind, ce.child_num, CAST(ce.qty AS BIGINT), ce.is_spare
    FROM roots r
    JOIN ce ON ce.parent_kind = 'set' AND ce.parent_num = r.set_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT x.root, ce.child_kind, ce.child_num, x.qty * ce.qty, ce.is_spare
    FROM x
    JOIN ce ON ce.parent_kind = x.kind AND ce.parent_num = x.num
    WHERE x.kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM x
WHERE kind = 'part' AND NOT is_spare;
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '10785-1'
),
total AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS t
    FROM u_explosion e, cur
    WHERE e.root_kind = 'set'
      AND e.root_num = '10785-1'
      AND e.root_version = cur.v
      AND e.item_kind = 'part'
      AND NOT e.is_spare
),
direct AS (

    FROM u_composition c, cur

      AND c.parent_num = '10785-1'
      AND c.version = cur.v
      AND c.child_kind = 'part'
      AND NOT c.is_spare
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (total.t - direct.d) / NULLIF(total.t, 0), 2) AS pct_from_nested
FROM total, direct;
```

```cypher
      (s)-[e2:EXPLODES]->(p:Part {part_num: '48336'})
WHERE e1.is_current = true
  AND e2.is_current = true
  AND e2.is_spare = false
RETURN count(DISTINCT s.set_num) AS num_sets
```

```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '10785-1'})-[e:EXPLODES]->(:Part)
WHERE e.is_current = true AND e.is_spare = false
WITH s, sum(e.qty) AS total
MATCH (s)-[c:CONTAINS]->()
WITH s, total, max(c.version) AS v
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[d:CONTAINS]->(:Part)
WHERE d.version = v AND d.is_spare = false
WITH total, coalesce(sum(d.qty), 0) AS direct
RETURN round(CAST(total - direct AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / CAST(total AS DOUBLE), 2) AS pct_from_nested
```
